entity.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange launched in 2018. ABCC wound down its Singapore virtual-asset exchange operation in 2024 while transferring global users to a continuing ABCC platform, later operated by Labuan-based Unicoin DCX Limited. The legacy spot-trading service closed in September 2025, but current 2026 first-party material continues to provide cryptocurrency buy/sell functionality through ABCC Wallet.
entity.notes: ABCC's current first-party site states that the exchange started in 2018; HEI normalizes that year-level date to 2018-01-01 because no reviewed source establishes an exact launch day. A 2024 first-party notice identifies Alphabit Consulting Pte Ltd as the Singapore ABCC operator, records the sunset of Singapore exchange operations, and says global users were transferred to Alphabit Limited / ABCC Global rather than the entire platform being closed. Current ABCC terms and first-party pages identify Unicoin DCX Limited in Labuan as the operator, and Labuan FSA's financial-institutions directory lists Unicoin DCX Limited as a current Money Broker / Credit Token Business. The exact corporate handoff from ABCC Global to Unicoin DCX is not reconstructed here, so entity confidence remains medium. The 2025 closure of ABCC's spot-trading service is recorded as a product-level trading_halted event; current 2026 ABCC Wallet documentation still exposes cryptocurrency buy/sell functionality, so HEI retains the entity as active rather than dead or inactive.

events.title: ABCC Exchange began operating
events.description: ABCC states that its cryptocurrency exchange started in 2018.
events.notes: Year-level launch marker normalized to 2018-01-01 because the reviewed first-party source does not provide an exact launch day.

events.title: ABCC ended its Singapore virtual-asset exchange operation
events.description: Alphabit Consulting Pte Ltd set 2024-08-23 as the closure date for ABCC's Singapore virtual-asset exchange business after disabling Singapore trading and onboarding, while global users were transferred to ABCC Global.
events.notes: This is a jurisdiction-specific operating-company closure, not a global ABCC shutdown. The same first-party notice states that global users could continue accessing trading accounts after transfer to ABCC Global.

events.title: ABCC closed its spot-trading service
events.description: ABCC announced that its spot-trading service would close effective 2025-09-01 as part of a platform refocus.
events.notes: The event applies to the spot-trading service rather than all ABCC activity. Current 2026 first-party wallet documentation continues to expose cryptocurrency buy/sell functionality, so the current entity status remains active.

evidence.title: ABCC Exchange cryptocurrency trading platform
evidence.notes: Current first-party site states that ABCC Exchange started in 2018 and presents a live cryptocurrency trading and fiat buy/sell surface.

evidence.title: Labuan Credit Token Companies financial institutions directory
evidence.notes: Current Labuan FSA directory lists Unicoin DCX Limited among Labuan Credit Token Companies; current ABCC first-party terms identify Unicoin DCX Limited as the platform operator.

evidence.title: Announcement: ABCC to sunset Singapore Operations
evidence.notes: First-party notice sets 2024-08-23 as the Singapore closure date, disables trading for Singapore users, and states that global users were transferred to Alphabit Limited / ABCC Global with continuing account access.

evidence.title: Closure of Spot Trading Service
evidence.notes: First-party announcement states that ABCC Exchange would close its spot-trading service effective 2025-09-01.

evidence.title: How to Trade Cryptocurrencies on ABCC Wallet?
evidence.notes: Current first-party wallet instructions expose cryptocurrency buy and sell flows and transaction-history handling, supporting continued active exchange functionality after the legacy spot-trading service closure.
